items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I was doing a big band show with what I’ll call a vintage big band, it was playing a concert. And I looked to my left and there was Darius Brubeck playing trombone.

ctx.x: Darius Brubeck? You played with him and everywhere from there to the Coasters.

Yes. Like I say I am versatile and jazz is my music but I bring something from all these experiences into my playing. I was doing a big band show with what I’ll call a vintage big band, it was playing a concert. And I looked to my left and there was Darius Brubeck playing trombone. And an excellent musician. And again he was coming out of his jazz context into the vintage music style to add something to his jazz repertoire. And an excellent musician, and I envy people that can jump from trombone and play bass as…
people automatically expect you to be great. And it’s something you have to deal with when your spouse is a musician.
